paper.title: A Query Is Not a Commitment: Learning to Correct Expert Answers in Online Deferral

settings.name_in_paper: Online learning to defer with post-answer responses (conditional response oracle)
unmapped: Action = choice of free prediction or expert j together with a correction coefficient vector a in a unit ball of Legendre polynomial features, fixed before observing the expert answer
Free action's loss observed every round (outcome always revealed); only queried expert answer revealed
Consultation fees beta_{t,j} added to cost
Conditional laws given history may vary over rounds and are not i.i.d.; regret is conditional pseudo-regret against per-round conditional oracle
Linear models of free risk and optimal queried risk in public features (Assumption 6.2), with known norm bounds Q_0, Q_*
Fixed feasible matrix per identity represents optimal response coefficients (Assumption 6.1)
Learner knows residual bound R and disagreement bound D
settings.definition_quote: Assume $|Y_t-h_t|\le R$ and $|M_{t,j}-h_t|\le D$ almost surely for every round and active expert, with known $R,D>0$. ... Our pseudo-regret is \Reg_T=\sum_{t=1}^T\{\E[C_t\mid\cF_t]-C_t^*\}.

symbols.C_prob: finite constant depending only on residual bounds, dimensions, registry capacity, regularizers, priors, parameter-norm bounds and pool rate

conditions: |Y_t - h_t| <= R and |M_{t,j} - h_t| <= D almost surely
non-intervention: purchasing does not change conditional joint law
Assumption 6.1: fixed feasible matrix Theta_j^* (||.||_F<=1) per identity gives optimal response coefficients
Assumption 6.2: free and optimal queried risks linear in public features with known norm bounds Q_0, Q_*
public features of norm at most one

source.label: thm:main-regret
source.quote: Assume the bounded non-interventional protocol ... Run \ORUCB{} with exact constrained response fits, full-history weighted queried-risk estimates, $0<\eta\le1/2$ and \cref{eq:main-calibration}. With probability at least $1-\delta$ over the joint interaction law, \Reg_T\le C_{\rm prob}\left\{\sqrt T\log\frac{T+1}{\delta}+\log\frac{T+1}{\delta}\right\}

results.notes: Regret is conditional pseudo-regret against per-round conditional oracle. With delta=(T+1)^{-2} gives O(sqrt(T) log(T+1)). Constant hides dimension dependence; notation O used since C_prob is unspecified.

symbols.G: R + D, bound on expert residual
symbols.B_0: free-risk confidence radius (1/2)sqrt(d_0 log(1+T/(d_0 lambda_0)) + 2 log(3/delta)) + Q_0
symbols.B_star: queried-risk confidence radius, same form with d_c, lambda_*, Q_*
symbols.N_T: total number of queries up to T
symbols.Ebar_T: deterministic response-error envelope 2[K lam_I + 8K p_I log(1+T/(K p_I lam_I)) + 4K log2/eta] + 64 log(3/delta)

source.label: prop:explicit-routing-bound
source.quote: Under the hypotheses and calibration of \cref{thm:main-regret}, with probability at least $1-\delta$, \Reg_T\le R^2B_0\mathcal W(T,d_0,\lambda_0)+G^2\left[16B_*\sqrt{N_T\mathcal H(N_T)}+4\overline E_T\mathcal H(N_T)+E_T\right].

results.notes: Explicit finite-horizon bound; depends on random query count N_T and pathwise E_T.

bound.expression_latex: R^2\left[(B_0+\varepsilon_0\sqrt T)\mathcal W(T,d_0,\lambda_0)+T\varepsilon_0\right]+G^2\left[16B_*^{\rm app}\sqrt{N_T\mathcal H(N_T)}+4\overline E_T^{\rm app}\mathcal H(N_T)+E_T^{\rm app}+8T\varepsilon_*\right]

symbols.E_T_app: 2A_T + 3 D_T + 128 log(3/delta), D_T cumulative response approximation error

conditions: approximate response model: excess risk of fixed feasible matrix over ball optimum in [0, eps_R]
approximate linear risk models with errors eps_0, eps_* and norm bounds Q_0, Q_*
public features of norm at most one
tuning: learner is supplied eps_R and eps_* for calibration

source.label: prop:approximate-models
source.quote: Assume the bounded non-interventional protocol ... and the approximation assumptions above ... With probability at least $1-\delta$ over the joint interaction law, \Reg_T\le R^2[(B_0+\varepsilon_0\sqrt T)\mathcal W(T,d_0,\lambda_0)+T\varepsilon_0]+G^2[16B_*^{\rm app}\sqrt{N_T\mathcal H(N_T)}+4\overline E_T^{\rm app}\mathcal H(N_T)+E_T^{\rm app}+8T\varepsilon_*]

results.notes: Misspecified models; paper remarks that for delta=(T+1)^{-2} this is O(sqrt(T)log(T+1) + T eps_R log(T+1) + T(eps_0+eps_*) sqrt(log(T+1))). Setting's realizability assumption is relaxed here.
